title: Will Watch Dis by Yung Miami have above 15000 Album Equivalent Units during the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026 tracking week? Above 15K
rules: If Watch Dis by Yung Miami has above 15K Album Equivalent Units during the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 23, 2026 - October 29, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: Watch Dis is Yung Miami's debut solo album, due Oct 23, 2026, so the Oct 23-29 window is its opening week. She is coming off her first solo top-20 Hot 100 hit ('Spend Dat', No. 17) and released two more singles with the announcement. Debut albums from comparable female rappers have recently opened above 15K, by my unchecked memory. Still, City Girls' album numbers have been modest, a delay would mean zero units, and I couldn't find any projections, so a fair amount of uncertainty remains.
blind.falsifier: The album slips past Oct 23, or first-week reporting (e.g., HitsDailyDouble/Billboard) shows Watch Dis debuting with under 15K units, such as a Billboard 200 debut outside the top 40.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.34, set near the end of the tracking week, likely reflects early sales projections I couldn't find, so I'm cutting my unchecked 0.67 estimate a lot. At 0.42 the edge over the 0.38 ask is too small to bet on given I'm the less-informed side.
